items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I was down there with the Blanche Calloway band.

ctx.x: To Peoria and we docked there for about two or three weeks.

Every night we was playing on this boat and you know we stopped at each town every night and give a dance right on the boat -- the boat ride -- you know. On the trip down to Missouri and up to Illinois.
